description: This file contains functions for resolving Matrix chat targets, including matching directory entries for users and groups, normalizing queries, and handling asynchronous lookups with caching. It exports the main function 'resolveMatrixTargets' which processes input strings to resolve Matrix IDs or directory entries.

methods.name: normalizeLookupQuery
methods.description: Trims and converts a query string to lowercase for normalization.

methods.name: findExactDirectoryMatches
methods.description: Finds directory entries that exactly match the normalized query based on id, name, or handle.

methods.name: pickBestGroupMatch
methods.description: Selects the best group match from a list of directory entries, prioritizing exact matches.

methods.name: pickBestUserMatch
methods.description: Selects the best user match from a list of directory entries, prioritizing exact matches.

methods.name: describeUserMatchFailure
methods.description: Provides a descriptive message when user matching fails.

methods.name: readCachedMatches
methods.description: Retrieves directory matches from cache or performs an async lookup if not cached.

methods.name: resolveMatrixTargets
methods.description: Main exported function that resolves a list of input strings to Matrix target IDs or directory entries, handling user and group types, with caching and error handling.
